title: SWF: DefineBitsLossless2 for PNG/GIF bitmaps
description: BitmapItem with compressionType='lossless' should encode as DefineBitsLossless2 (tag 36) in compile.ts. Currently all bitmaps may go through JPEG path. Add logic: if compressionType=lossless, decode the dataUri PNG to RGBA pixels, encode as ZLIB-compressed DefineBitsLossless2 with colorTableSize=0 (32bpp ARGB). Place the bitmap via PlaceObject2 on the correct frame. Add unit tests in packages/swf/src/__tests__/bitslossless.test.ts.
